why: Three lane B readings (exec/run.mjs; design/bench-drops.md). (1) An aliased module of the package whose top level cannot run in the sandbox is the environment's module: settings.ts is reached through the project's own `@/` alias and reads a host global the sandbox does not give at load, as a bundler's import.meta.env, a browser's localStorage or require.resolve do in real repositories. Before, loading it failed and every unit of the file was ASK (parent: load failed); now the alias is a fake, the same on both sides, as every alias was before aliases were loaded for real. warn moves its threshold from > 3 to >= 3: notify('high') against notify('low') at code 3, and nothing else differs, so the difference passes through the module lean could not load: ASK naming settings.ts and its load failure (a WITNESS before the third reading), lane A does not prove it. label is the same choice written as an if statement: proved, PASS-bounded. twice is untouched: proved, PASS-bounded. (2) A render's own pending continuations settle before its requests are read: useStatus (status.ts, an alias that loads) starts a promise chain whose last step calls notify after the render. Before, that call landed in the second render's trace and the component was REFUSE render-impure; now each render's trace holds its own work. Badge is untouched: PASS-bounded, proved. Tag adds a text child: WITNESS, and lane A does not prove it (the identity guard withholds the lemma). (3) A difference whose only trace passes through such a module is ASK, never a WITNESS (exec/run.mjs, unloadableOnly; design/bench-drops.md, Reading 3): lean could not load settings.ts, so it cannot say that a call to it or an inlined copy of it differs. report calls the module's helper announce in the parent and inlines its body (a call of notify) in the candidate: the only difference is a request to the module, ASK (a WITNESS before), lane A does not prove it. level calls the module the same way on both sides and moves the threshold of the label it returns: the outcome differs, WITNESS, lane A does not prove it. A module that loads (status.ts) keeps its real reading.
